440:
You? You have our deepest apologies
and our thanks. Take off the wig, wash off the tattoos,
441:
go home and celebrate New Year.
Thank you very much. - What about my men?
442:
We'll return your charges
to prison today.
443:
If you find the cloakroom attendant,
might you need us again?
444:
I didn't want to tell you, but Bely,
the real Docent, escaped today.
445:
Incredible, but true.
It's dangerous for you to look like him.
446:
Could we wait until tomorrow?
It's New Year. They've tried, in their own way.
447:
We're outside the city.
I doubt Docent could find us.
448:
Very well, but don't leave the house!
We forwarded your letter
449:
to Sheremetyev's wife.
Here's her reply, addressed to him.
450:
- Have lunch with us on New Year's Day. Promise?
- We promise!
451:
Such a nice woman.
Shame her father's a black-market dealer.
452:
What's all this shouting?
Who said you could go out? - He's back. Bad man.
454:
A new year is here. I wish you
a fresh start in the year ahead.
455:
Anything can happen, but remember:
wherever you are, wherever I am,
456:
I'll always remember you.
I'll be sure to find you.
457:
- And now... Just a moment...
- Where's he off to?
458:
Who knows? You can't make sense
of anything he says these days.
459:
What's not to understand? He says
he'll find us anywhere and slit our throats.
461:
They say he drew a razor across Speckle's throat. Just like that.
- He's gone savage, that jackal.
462:
Who has come to see you here?
Father Frost with gifts and cheer!
463:
- Come here, Fedya. - What did I do?
- Come on. Wear these in good health. They're slippers.
464:
- What do I need slippers for? I don't have a home.
- You will. Your life's ahead of you.
465:
- They'll come in handy in prison for now.
- Always with the doom and gloom.
466:
This is for you, Vasya.
Gavrila Petrovich, this one's yours. - Thank you.
467:
- Pure wool.
- This is for you too.
469: Too sour. It's dull without vodka.
470:
- Must you get drunk as a pig?
- What else is there to do?
471: We could sit and have a heart-to-heart.
472:
I'm not a prosecutor. I'm not having
a heart-to-heart with you. - We could play a game.
473:
Listen to him! You think I'm dumb enough
to play cards with you? Your deck has nine aces.
474: Why does it have to be cards?
475:
Here's a good game: cities.
I say "Moscow."
476:
You take the last letter, W: Warsaw.
Then the W again: Washington. See?
477:
Your turn, Fedya. Name a city
beginning with N.
478:
Vorkuta.
Why? I did time there.
479:
- All right. Your turn, beginning with A.
- Dzhambul. - Where did that come from?
480:
It's warm there. That's my home.
My mother lives there.
481:
Let's play this instead. I'll go outside,
you hide something, and I'll find it.
482:
- If only you'd find our helmet.
- Be quiet.
483:
- We hide it, and he peeks through a hole?
- No. You can go out and hide it.
484:
You can make sure I don't peek.
- Why me? Any job, and it's always Fedya!
485:
- I'll rip your maw off, you little pest!
- Your maw, your maw...
486:
- Docent, were you ever little?
- Yes.
487:
- Did you have a mother and father?
- Yes.
488:
Why are you so mean?
Why are you like a dog?
490:
- You came to me.
- Ah, you're here too.
491:
I went looking for you,
but I could tell the place was staked out.
492: Mityai, I need somewhere to hide.
494:
- Where are we going?
- Keep walking.
495:
- Sorry to trouble you for nothing, doctor.
- It's all right.
496:
Give him valerian and warm tea,
then let him sleep. - Thank you.
497:
- Does it hurt, Garik?
- It does, Vasya. Read it.
499:
"Dear Dad, we found out
that you're in prison,
500:
and we were very happy,
because we thought you were dead."
501:
Who was the rat
that told his kid about him?
502:
"Mom was happy too.
When your letter arrived, she cried all day.
503:
Before that, she said
you were a test pilot."
505:
"I'm still glad you're alive,
because Mom says you're a good person,
507:
That's right! So weak-willed he pinched
our money and blamed the taxi driver.
508:
Scarper! I'll knock your horns off,
you rotten radish!
510:
Aren't you ashamed? You're forty years old.
Half your life is gone!
511:
What's behind you? What do you have now?
What's ahead?
512:
Darkness, filth, nothing human!
Come to your senses before it's too late. That's my advice.
513:
Listen, Docent. We need to clear out.
That doctor will tell the police.
514:
- She won't. - Why?
- I took my razor to her throat.
515:
She's in the well.
Go and see for yourself.
516: What did I have? One year.
517: What will I get for escaping? Three!
518:
For the nursery and the apartment?
Say ten!
520:
Am I going to put up with that snake
for a lousy fourteen years?
521:
The one who put the old lady in the well?
Do what you want. I'm going to the police.
522: Go on. He won't hurt you.
523:
And you? Will you put up with him
until the day you die?
524:
Vasya, the other day I told him
I had a cold, and he...
525:
Enough about your cold!
Come here...
527:
- What's going on?
- We're cleaning the carpet.
528:
Listen, comrades. The show's over.
First, I'm taking this off.
530:
I'll serve my time, and that's it.
I'm going straight! I'll get a job.
531:
- Doing what? A watchman on my old collective farm.
- Why a watchman?
532:
I could clear snow, lay bricks,
or be a translator. I know English.
533:
If only we could bring back helmet!
Docent is crook.
534:
- Plenty crooks, only one helmet.
- They'd cut our sentences for it.
535:
Where'd he put it?
We went everywhere.
536:
Crook! I told you I had a cold,
and all you said was, "Your maw!"
537:
- Made me dive in freezing water!
- When did he make you dive?
538:
When they arrested us! Remember?
He said, "I'm fishing. You dive."
539:
- Wait. What did he say about fishing?
- "I'm fishing through the ice,
540:
and you, Squint, can you swim?"
- He hid the helmet in that hole!
541:
That's it! I remember, the bad man!
In the ice hole at Malakhovka!
542:
Why didn't you say something, you lout?
You could've left a note before hanging yourself. - Let's go.
543:
- What about him?
- Let them collect him. I'm not carrying that great lump. Come on!
545:
- There's nothing there.
- It's at the bottom. You have to dive.
546:
Why me? Any job, and it's always Squint.
Vasya, tell him to dive himself.
547: I can't! It's cold. I'll get sick.
548:
- You just tried to hang yourself, and now you fear a cold?
- Greetings, fellow athletes!
550:
- Where's the boat station?
- Over there.
551:
I'd kill you both,
but I haven't got the time!
552:
Now there are two of them.
And another one back at the country house.
555:
- Two.
- The more we turn in, the better.
